Adapter Registry with Auto-Discovery

Provides a central registry for framework adapters, with support for
manual registration, decorator-based registration, and automatic
discovery of BaseIntegration subclasses.
member_docstrings: AdapterRegistry: Singleton registry for framework adapters.

register_adapter: Class decorator that registers an adapter in the global registry.

Usage::

register: Register an adapter class under the given name.
